name: 993 dashboard trim, composite, vehicles without passenger airbag (PicoGK)
material_candidate: organic matrix composite, fibre and resin to be determined
picogk_enhancement: Replaces the rectangular U-channel with a crowned, smoothed skin that rolls over a crest into the occupant face, bows forward in plan and tucks down at the pillar ends; return flanges at the windscreen edge and under the front face, an instrument opening with a hanging return flange, face vents with louvre vanes and transverse stiffening ribs inside, all open from below (no closed pocket).

length_mm.note: F0 span between pillars (scripts/build_993_concept_f0.py hypothesis), bounded by the 1735 mm vehicle width

depth_mm.note: F0 trim depth hypothesis, including the plan bow

height_mm.note: F0 trim height hypothesis, at the crest

vehicle_width_bound_mm.note: SRC-ASTRA-993-TYPE-APPROVAL-DIMENSIONS vehicle width; an upper bound only, not used by the geometry

rear_height_mm.note: height of the windscreen-side return flange

crest_offset_mm.note: crest position from the profile centre (negative = toward the occupants)

plan_bow_mm.note: forward bow of the centre in plan

end_taper_ratio.note: height reduction at the pillar ends

end_taper_start_ratio.note: taper starts at this fraction of the length from the centre

edge_smooth_mm.note: smoothing radius of all outer edges

front_lip_mm.note: return flange width under the occupant face (knee-strip side; attachment points unknown)

instrument_opening_x_mm.note: instrument hood opening centre, driver side of a LHD car

instrument_opening_length_mm.note: instrument opening length; hood interface not measured

opening_flange_depth_mm.note: return flange hanging under the instrument opening

centre_vent_x_mm.note: two centre face vents at +/- this offset

centre_vent_width_mm.note: centre vent width; vent units not measured

side_vent_x_mm.note: round side vents near the pillar ends

vane_depth_mm.note: louvre vane depth behind the face

rib_clearance_mm.note: ribs stop this far above the bottom so every bay stays open

open_interfaces: SCOPE: M564 (no airbag) or Carrera RS 'without Airbag' only; never on an M561/M562 car
instrument hood, air vents, steering column, glovebox, console junction, pillars and windscreen base - not measured
clip-nut and self-tapping screw positions unknown (not drawn)
knee protection strip attachment points (964 552 053 00 / 993 552 054 00) must stay identical - unknown
status: F0 concept geometry - not fitted, not tested, not safe, not released, not a print file
